title: CAFFEINE + THEANINE
prompt: It hides tiredness, it does not add energy | Theanine is why tea feels smoother | Steadier attention, less jitter | Afternoon coffee is tomorrow's tiredness | Not medical advice
style: clean modern product photography, soft diffused daylight, shallow depth of field, matte surfaces, muted natural palette, minimal composition, crisp focus, high detail
line: Caffeine blocks the signal that makes you feel tired. It does not add energy - it hides the debt. Green tea carries theanine alongside it, which is why tea tends to feel smoother than the same caffeine from coffee. Together they show up in the research as steadier attention with less of the jittery edge. The catch is the same as always: it has a long tail, and afternoon coffee is tomorrow's tiredness. General information, not medical advice. Talk to a doctor about what fits you.
